title: Justice Dept. Confirms Alaska Inquiry Even as Its Focus Remains Unclear
summary: Democrats and former officials have accused the department of pursuing a political goal in the guise of a legal one: to publicize a scheme, sordid but not illegal under state law, damaging to Democrats.
